peg_tip_from_rgbd — DRIVE pegsim op

• Data kinds: rgb × image2d × matrix → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.peg_tip_from_rgbd(rgb, depth, K, r_peg: 'float' = 0.005, peg_mask=None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import pegsim; pegsim.peg_tip_from_rgbd(rgb, depth, K, r_peg: 'float' = 0.005, peg_mask=None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("peg_tip_from_rgbd"))

Usage

Peg tip center in 3-D (camera coordinates) from 1 wrist RGB-D frame: peg pixels → depth point cloud → PCA axis → known-radius cylinder fit; the tip's position along the axis is set by a model that matches the end of the shadow (subpixel, coverage) to the end of the projected edge circle.

Returns: tip_cam (3,), axis (tip → up, unit), rms_cyl, n_pts, uv (projection of the tip), delta_axial.

Honestly: over 16 poses in the prototype, the axial error was max 0.83 px (lateral 0.004 px) — the limit of reading the axial direction only from the coverage of the single pixel at the shadow edge; the target of 0.3 px is not met. Raises RuntimeError: the peg is not visible (core pixels < 50).

Empty input (rgb with 0 elements) raises ValueError.
